_comment: Supplemental sources for public/data/malicious-packages.json. This file does not replace the SSOT; scripts/build_malicious_package_index.py can use it to enrich the SSOT from advisory feeds that are not covered completely by the Datadog sample tree.

tanstack_may_2026.name: TanStack May 2026 npm supply-chain compromise
tanstack_may_2026.notes: OSV/GHSA is preferred for affected TanStack package names and exact malicious versions. The TanStack postmortem is preferred for incident context and clean-package clarifications.

external_advisory_supplement.name: External advisory supplemental package source
external_advisory_supplement.notes: Used for advisories that are not represented completely by the Datadog sample tree. Entries should keep exact package names and versions from machine-readable advisory feeds when available.

socket_research_2026.name: Socket security research disclosures (2025–2026)
socket_research_2026.notes: Packages confirmed malicious by Socket's supply-chain security research but not yet reflected in OSSF/OSV. Manually curated entries; update osv_id field if/when an OSSF advisory is published.

bufferzonecorp_may_2026.name: BufferZoneCorp Go/Ruby malware campaign (May 2026)
bufferzonecorp_may_2026.notes: 10 Go modules + 7 Ruby gems impersonating popular libraries; GOPROXY poisoning, SSH persistence, CI token theft.

trapdoor_may_2026.name: TrapDoor crypto stealer campaign (May 2026)
trapdoor_may_2026.notes: 21 npm + 7 PyPI + 6 crates.io packages; trap-core.js 1,149-line harvester; targets crypto wallets, SSH, AWS, GitHub; .cursorrules/CLAUDE.md AI injection.

contagious_interview_2026.name: Contagious Interview / DPRK supply-chain campaign (2026)
contagious_interview_2026.notes: 1,700+ packages across npm, PyPI, Go, crates.io, Packagist; ecw_update.zip RAT; apachelicense.vercel.app C2.

ir_chinese_ui_2026.name: IR.* Chinese UI libraries malware (NuGet, May 2026)
ir_chinese_ui_2026.notes: 5 NuGet packages wrapping AntdUI (Gitee); .NET Reactor Necrobit JIT-hook; 12-browser harvest; ~65K downloads.

sicoob_sdk_2026.name: Sicoob Banking SDK impersonation (NuGet, May 2026)
sicoob_sdk_2026.notes: Exfiltrates client ID + PFX certificate via Sentry telemetry; 484 downloads before NuGet blocked.

osv_advisories.notes: TanStack router/start package compromise. Import exact affected packages and versions from OSV rather than copying KISA package names verbatim.
CanisterWorm: react-leaflet-heatmap-layer compromise. OSV advisory pins exact malicious version.

kisa_listed_packages._comment: Packages on the KISA Supply Chain Diffusion Attack hunting guide that are NOT confirmed compromised by a machine-readable OSV/GHSA advisory. We add them to the SSOT anyway under a recall-first policy. confidence reflects KISA-vs-upstream agreement; category stays conservative because we do not know if the package is malicious_intent (typosquat) or compromised_legitimate (hijacked version) without a version-level signal.

policy.confirmed_when: KISA-listed AND npm registry returns 404 (consistent with post-incident unpublish/takedown).
policy.suspected_when: KISA-listed AND npm registry returns 200 AND no OSV/GHSA advisory confirms compromise. Often disputed by upstream postmortem.
policy.exclude_when: Upstream maintainer postmortem explicitly names the package as unaffected.

upstream_carveouts.reason: TanStack postmortem explicitly names @tanstack/start (the meta-package, not @tanstack/start-*) as unaffected.

manual_review_aliases.reason: KISA-style list and Datadog/local SSOT differ; validate against JFrog/Datadog/npm before adding as a new package.

manual_packages.name: github.com/shopsprint/decimal
manual_packages.notes: 6-year dormant typosquat of shopspring/decimal. init() fires DNS TXT C2 lookup to dnslog-cdn-images.freemyip.com on every go build. Permanently cached in proxy.golang.org (immutable). Detected May 19, 2026.

manual_packages.name: github.com/golangorg/formstash
manual_packages.notes: DPRK Contagious Interview; impersonates mime/multipart parser. Hidden loader in helper func contacts apachelicense.vercel.app; delivers ecw_update.zip RAT. Detected April 7, 2026.

manual_packages.name: IR.DantUI
manual_packages.notes: Wraps AntdUI (Gitee Chinese WinForms library); .NET Reactor Necrobit JIT-hook; targets 12 browsers and 8 crypto wallets; exfils to newly-registered C2. ~65K downloads across IR.* family. Publisher: bmrxntfj. Detected May 6, 2026.

manual_packages.name: IR.OscarUI
manual_packages.notes: Same IR.* campaign; exfils to C:\ProgramData\Microsoft OneDrive\keys.dat.

manual_packages.name: IR.Infrastructure.Core
manual_packages.notes: Stage-1 module initializer in IR.* campaign; RWX VirtualAlloc; InjectorSharp.

manual_packages.name: IR.iplus32
manual_packages.notes: All 5 IR.* packages published 12.78 seconds apart (scripted pipeline).

manual_packages.name: Sicoob.Sdk
manual_packages.notes: Impersonates Brazilian Sicoob banking cooperative C# SDK. Exfiltrates client ID, PFX password, and base64-encoded PFX certificate via Sentry telemetry. 484 downloads before NuGet blocked. Detected May 28, 2026.

manual_packages.name: Sharp7Extend
manual_packages.notes: Targets Siemens S7 PLC via Sharp7 library (industrial Ethernet communication). ICS/SCADA supply chain attack. Not yet in OSSF/OSV as of June 2026.

manual_packages.name: Tracer.Fody.NLog
manual_packages.notes: Targets Stratis blockchain wallet users. IL weaving disguise via Fody. Credential and wallet theft. Detected December 2025.

manual_packages.name: dev-log-core
manual_packages.notes: DPRK Contagious Interview; impersonates debug/pino-debug. Contacts apachelicense.vercel.app; downloads ecw_update.zip RAT. Detected April 7, 2026.

manual_packages.name: logger-base
manual_packages.notes: DPRK Contagious Interview; GitHub alias golangorg; staged RAT loader.

manual_packages.notes: DPRK Contagious Interview; staged RAT loader.
